title: Pre-Registered Research Protocol: Multi-Category Adaptive Cost-Weighted Budget Allocation (MACBA) for Human-in-the-Loop Industrial Anomaly Detection
target_journals: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (T-PAMI)

hypothesis.primary_statement: In multi-product industrial manufacturing environments operating under a global bounded human review capacity (B <= 20% of plant throughput) and asymmetric error costs (c_FN >> c_FP), category-aware review allocation driven by decision-theoretic expected loss reduction Delta L(X) and calibrated non-conformity percentiles achieves statistically superior Realized Cost Reduction and Defect Escape Reduction (MC-DER) compared to uniform category partitioning (BL0), volume-proportional allocation (BL1), and globally pooled distance ranking (BL2).
hypothesis.novelty_barrier: The proposed allocation method must demonstrate statistically significant improvement (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test across multi-category bootstrap resamples, p < 0.05, Holm-Bonferroni corrected) over Uniform Allocation (BL0) and Global Distance Pooling (BL2) across independent evaluation categories without requiring defect training samples.
hypothesis.realistic_positioning: Acknowledges prior foundations in cost-sensitive reject options (Chow 1970; Charoenphakdee 2021) and capacity-constrained deferral (Alves 2024; Reid 2024). Positioned strictly as the first systematic study of multi-category factory-wide triage for frozen distance-based anomaly detectors.

development_feasibility_subset.name: MVTec AD Development Subset (bottle, capsule, metal_nut)

quarantined_independent_benchmarks.name: VisA (Visual Anomaly Dataset — 11 Untouched Categories)
quarantined_independent_benchmarks.quarantine_rule: Strictly quarantined until Protocol V3.1 is formally frozen and approved.

quarantined_independent_benchmarks.name: BTAD (BeanTech Anomaly Detection)
quarantined_independent_benchmarks.quarantine_rule: Strictly quarantined until Protocol V3.1 is formally frozen and approved.

mathematical_model.expected_loss_reduction: Delta L(X) = p_hat(X) * p_sens * c_FN - (1 - p_hat(X)) * (1 - p_spec) * c_FP - c_rev (for automated pass); (1 - p_hat(X)) * p_spec * c_FP - p_hat(X) * (1 - p_sens) * c_FN - c_rev (for automated reject)
mathematical_model.optimization_policy: Greedy marginal utility ranking by r(X) = max(Delta L(X), 0) / c_rev subject to sum c_rev * A <= B_capacity

baselines: BL0: Uniform Category Allocation with within-category boundary ranking
BL1: Volume-Proportional Allocation with within-category boundary ranking
BL2: Globally Pooled Raw Distance-to-Threshold Ranking
BL3: Globally Pooled Category-Normalized Boundary Ranking
BL7: Oracle Allocation Using Evaluation Labels (Upper Bound)

stopping_rules.stop_rule_1: If MACBA fails to outperform Uniform Allocation (BL0) by at least +5.0% cost reduction on independent evaluation.
stopping_rules.stop_rule_2: If MACBA fails to outperform Global Distance Pooling (BL2) on independent evaluation.
stopping_rules.stop_rule_3: If optimization latency exceeds 10 ms per batch.
